reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must accept FUNCTION DATE-OF-INTEGER ( argument-1 ) with exactly one integer argument, as an integer function inside an arithmetic expression, and refuse no list, an empty list, two arguments, a reference-modifier on the integer result, and the function written where an identifier stands.

edition-consulted.switches: D8 window (IntroducedIn 85, admitted); and DialectBehavior IntegerDateFormBounded read into IntegerDateFormUnbounded: at 85 the integer date form has no 9999 upper bound
construct NumericFunctionIdentifierOperand2002: MOVE FUNCTION DATE-OF-INTEGER (1) TO D refused below 2002

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 an empty list and the identifier-operand position are refused, and the returned-value range is unbounded above (day 3067672 gives 100000101 at 85 and 0 at 2023); the one-argument format is the same code
